channel.title: Temitope F. Egbedeyi — Ideas, Scholarship & Public Engagement
channel.description: Writing on education, research, politics, society, world affairs, professional life, and public scholarship.

item.title: How AI Can Write an Almost Meaningful Research Article
item.description: Generative AI can produce polished academic prose in seconds. But fluent writing is not the same thing as knowledge. A reflection on how researchers can leverage AI without surrendering the human responsibility behind meaningful scholarship.

item.title: Social Class, Childhood, and Educational Opportunity: Reflecting on Annette Lareau
item.description: A reflection on Annette Lareau's scholarship examining how social class shapes childhood, parenting, educational opportunity, and inequality, with perspectives from the United States and Nigeria.

item.title: Why the Way Children Think About Mathematics Matters
item.description: A correct answer tells us something. How a child arrived at it can tell us much more. A reflection on multiplication, children’s strategies, and what we can learn when we stop to ask, “How did you get it?”
